links.outcome: Usability, conversation quality and summary quality by interaction language versus English
links.effect: Hindi reached parity with English on all dimensions. Mandarin had a significant conversation quality gap. Spanish had significant deficits in both conversation quality and summary quality. Trust and workload were consistent across languages.
links.quote: Spanish demonstrated significant deficits in both conversation quality and summary quality.

unlisted_practices: Comparing chatbot performance in English versus non-English languages using bilingual role-play participants before deployment

screen.reason: Evaluates the multilingual performance, usability, and equity of an LLM pre-visit planning chatbot through simulated patient interactions across multiple languages.
